answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in shale, checked in ridge, and vault reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1248 identities would post 4439 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
